title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
statementMd:
Merge two already-sorted arrays into one sorted array in **O(n + m)** — the key step of merge sort. Walk both arrays with two pointers, always taking the smaller front element.

**Input**
Line 1: `n`, then n sorted integers. Next line: `m`, then m sorted integers. (n, m ≥ 0, n + m ≥ 1)

**Output**
All n + m integers in sorted order, space-separated.
hints: Keep index i into a and j into b. Take a[i] if it is ≤ b[j], else b[j], and advance that index.
When one array runs out, copy the rest of the other.
